contract.driftNote: Historical proof details in PRODUCT.md are not used as current release evidence.
contract.audience: Owner and product teams tracking portfolio activity, acquisition and health.
contract.job: Within two minutes identify meaningful breakouts and problems, scan numbers for all 55 projects, and open the corresponding product or source.
contract.thesis: An editorial Morning briefing leads with meaningful changes, actual activity and acquisition sources, followed by a complete project ledger.
contract.system: Preserve graphite shadcn surfaces and system sans typography. Sky marks browser/source activity, emerald comparable growth and actions, amber attention, red measured failures, neutral unavailable or not applicable. Use clear period and counting-unit labels.
contract.signature: Connect each meaningful change to its project numbers and recorded traffic sources without inventing attribution.
contract.risk: Small baselines and the bot-filter cutover can produce misleading growth. Suppress confident labels when comparability or coverage fails; no-referrer is not guessed as a platform.
